what_this_proves: The two operator allowlists are one file. packages/protocol/operator-allowlists.json names the seven applications (with Turkish names, images and spoken aliases), the device's eight terminal patterns and the three commands the cloud sends, the images process.stop may end and the services service.restart may touch; app/operator/allowlists.py reads it at import (plans.APP_ALLOWLIST IS the contract's id tuple), and a C# test holds DefaultApplications/DefaultAllowlist/DefaultStoppableImages/DefaultRestartableServices equal to the same file while a Python test reads the C# source too. On top of that: an application is closed BY NAME through its own window found by image in the device's list (app.close, WM_CLOSE, a save prompt reported as modal and never answered); a window is moved and resized with the rect re-observed within 8 px; the third shell query (whoami) speaks the user part; process.list/process.stop and service.status/service.restart exist on the device (Process table + Win32_Service through System.Management) and in the cloud, with both policies refused as permission_denied BEFORE any device call, and an unelevated companion answering a restart with permission_denied that names UAC rather than bypassing it.

measured_first.allowlists_before: plans.APP_ALLOWLIST had six ids, the device's DefaultApplications() seven (mspaint device-only); shell_query knew ip/hostname (two commands) against the device's eight patterns; no test read both halves.
measured_first.callers_before: app.close, window.move, window.resize implemented on the device since M19 (the lifecycle lab test exercises them) with no cloud caller; window.minimize/maximize/restore already had cloud callers (operator.window_control since M19, corpus op.window.*) - rows 86-88 were stale, not missing.
measured_first.process_service_before: no process.* or service.* capability on the device (OperatorCapabilityNames.All = 32); no cloud tool; no intents.

closed_fully.82_app_close: Intent APP_CLOSE ('Not Defteri'ni kapat', 'Chrome'u kapat') -> operator.app_close: the application's window is found by IMAGE in the device's own window.list (never the focus stack), plan close_application = app.close (postcondition closed) + window.list (window gone); not running -> noop/already 'zaten açık değil' with no close sent; modal -> modal_open 'kaydedilmemiş bir şey soruyor'; force only on the owner's word.
closed_fully.84_85_move_resize: operator.window_control action=move (x,y) / resize (width,height) -> plans move_window/resize_window: device window.move/window.resize, postcondition the re-observed rect within RECT_TOLERANCE_PX=8 (the companion's own tolerance); a rect that did not land is postcondition_failed 'Pencereyi boyutlandıramadım'.
closed_fully.86_87_88_min_max_restore: already callable (operator.window_control minimize/maximize/restore, corpus op.window.* cases); matrix rows corrected from 'çağıran yok' to DONE with their existing tests.

closed_fully.122_service_restart_policy: device service.restart: DefaultRestartableServices policy, then IsElevated() - unelevated -> permission_denied naming UAC, nothing touched; elevated -> StopService/StartService via WMI and the state re-read until Running; cloud operator.service action=restart refuses not_in_restart_policy first, plan service_restart = service.restart (restarted) + service.status (running); tier CRITICAL. Intent SERVICE_RESTART ('Spooler servisini yeniden başlat'); bare 'Yeniden başlat' stays REPEAT.

found_on_the_way.the_lab_reached_the_owners_notepad: The first run of the process.stop lab test sent WM_CLOSE to the owner's own unsaved a.txt Notepad (process.stop is by image, as the product promises) and, correctly, reported its save prompt as modal and answered nothing. On this desktop the new capabilities ran for real: process.list found the test host by image, process.stop refused powershell.exe/svchost.exe by policy, service.status read Spooler from the SCM, service.restart refused bthserv by policy and Spooler with the UAC answer (unelevated), the state unchanged before/after.

owner_gates.uac_service_restart: service.restart needs an elevated companion; the companion runs in the owner's session unelevated by design, so a real restart is READY_FOR_OWNER (checkpoint: the owner decides whether the companion may ever run elevated; the product never bypasses UAC)
